title: Event envelope
description: The common shape of every event in AntojoPOS. See docs/technical-design.md §3. Doesn't change without versioning: it's the contract between all eight services.

event_type.description: <service>.<aggregate>.<fact in past tense>.v<n>. Describes something that already happened.

branch_id.description: Absent only in tenant-scoped events (e.g. tenant.created).

correlation_id.description: Travels from the first HTTP request and threads through the whole saga.

causation_id.description: event_id of the event that caused this one. Null if it's first in the chain.
